meta.data_as_of: 2026-11-04 ~21:52 ET (NBC refresh of uncalled/partial races; earlier races as of ~11:10 ET)
notes: Level 1: archetypes below minimum N: left_populist, center_populist -> u_a = 0 for those archetypes (structural prediction only); cells greyed
Level 2: interactions below minimum N (no district composition) -> gamma = 0; tilt disabled

Level 3: district demographics missing for 100% of rows (> 25%) -> ES_re and ES_age dropped; rely on the m24 spline and the state effects/Mundlak terms. Banner: the wave's demographic shape is only partly controlled. (State-level ES would be collinear with alpha_s.)
E24 computed from certified state totals in states.json = -1.500 (METHODOLOGY text says -1.43; see SCHEMA_NOTES.md)

Primary model: Z uses state-level composition (district primary electorates not on disk); priors eta ~ N(0,0.5^2) (no 2016/2020 exit-poll file); Laplace approximation for draws; delegates and calendar are approximations of the 2024 DNC rules/calendar.
Units: UT 2016 margin carries the McMullin flag and is never used in a lean
